_comment: One entry per exam paper. permission.status: granted (written permission from the institution, with license), published-open (already published under an open license), pending (asked, not yet granted: items may only go in the private test split), example (format example). held_out: true keeps a paper's items out of the public dev split even when permission allows publishing, to protect against contamination. Keep permission letters off GitHub; record who granted it and when.
